title: A name tidier
description:
Clean up names typed in any style.

```
tidy("  ada   LOVELACE ")       ->  "Ada Lovelace"
initials("grace brewster hopper") ->  "G. B. H."
username("Ada Lovelace", 1815)    ->  "alovelace1815"
```
hints: `name.trim().split(" ")` splits on single spaces, so a run of spaces gives empty words (`""`). Loop over the words with `for...of`, skip the empty ones with `continue`, and `push` each tidied word into an array: `word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase()`. Finish with `join(" ")`.
`username` can call `tidy` first, so it always works on clean words.
requirements: `tidy(name)` trims, collapses repeated spaces and capitalises each word.
`initials(name)` returns the first letter of each word, upper case, each followed by a dot, joined by spaces.
`username(name, year)` is the first letter of the first name plus the last name, lower case, plus the year.
stretch: Keep small words like `van` and `de` in lower case unless they are the first word.
